io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.access: Read-only. No SQL tool and no write tools.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.auth: OAuth 2.1 (PKCE S256, dynamic client registration or Client ID Metadata Documents, scope cvr:read) discovered from the 401 WWW-Authenticate header. Developer clients can instead send Authorization: Bearer ls_live_... (API key from the account page). initialize and tools/list work without sign-in, so clients and directories can list the tools; every tool call needs an account.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.data: About 948,000 Danish companies, master data synced from CVR daily; annual-report figures for about 460,000. Companies with CVR advertising protection (reklamebeskyttelse) are excluded by default and flagged with contact_warning.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.data_license: Data from the Danish Central Business Register (CVR), Danish Business Authority (Erhvervsstyrelsen), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Credit the source when you reuse the data.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: Free during the beta: 20,000 credits per account per month, no card needed (1 credit per successful call). Published prices apply after the beta (prepaid credits from 50 DKK, monthly plans from 39 DKK excl. VAT), announced by email at least 30 days before.
